# NUMU

> NUMU (نمو) is an Arabic-first e-commerce platform built for merchants in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and the wider MENA region. It bundles native integrations with Egyptian payment gateways (Paymob, Fawry, Kashier, Fawaterak, InstaPay), mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, WE Pay, Orange Cash) and bank transfer, shipping with Bosta, Mylerz and J&T Express (or the merchant's own courier), Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-invoicing, and WhatsApp/Instagram/Facebook selling into a single bilingual dashboard.

Launched to solve the pain points generic global platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce) leave for MENA merchants: no native Arabic RTL storefronts, no Paymob/Fawry/Bosta connectors, no ETA e-invoicing, and no Cash-on-Delivery (COD) fee management.

## Key facts

- Operator (legal business name): يحيى شريف ابراهيم محمد, trading as NUMU (نُمُو)
- Headquarters: Cairo, Egypt
- [Website](https://numueg.app/en)
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English
- Countries served: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman
- Pricing: 37-day free trial (no credit card), Starter from 250 EGP/month, and Pay as you Grow with no monthly subscription. Full details: [pricing](https://numueg.app/en/pricing)
- Order limits: Starter, Pro, Enterprise, and Pay as you Grow accept unlimited orders. The old 50-order figure is not a Starter-plan limit. The 37-day free trial currently includes 80 orders.

## Platform capabilities

- Payment gateways: Paymob, Fawry, Kashier, Fawaterak, InstaPay, and Moyasar for Saudi stores (Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, Apple Pay, valU instalments, wallets); one online gateway is live at a time, next to cash on delivery; manual wallets Vodafone Cash, WE Pay and Orange Cash, and bank transfer, all with receipt upload; an optional deposit to confirm a COD order
- Shipping: Bosta, Mylerz and J&T Express integrations (waybills, tracking, returns), or the merchant's own courier on a NUMU waybill with a shopper tracking page; couriers without an API (Egypt Post, Cathedis, MCS, R2S, Xceed, EGL, Waselha, Flextock, Holy Ship, Barashout, Sprint) get the day's parcels as a CSV sheet plus a WhatsApp message, with outcomes imported back by file; governorate-based rates, bulk labels, COD reconciliation with the courier
- Cash on Delivery (COD): configurable fees per governorate / tier
- Tax compliance: automatic ETA (Egyptian Tax Authority) e-invoice generation per transaction
- Storefront: 18 premium themes, native Arabic RTL rendering, custom domain with an automatically issued certificate, store blog
- Multi-channel selling: website, WhatsApp Business, Instagram Shopping, Facebook Shops — one inventory
- AI tooling: bilingual product description generation (Arabic + English); "Connect your AI" (MCP) to run the store from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
- Imports: Instagram/Facebook catalogue import; CSV/Excel import of products, customers and orders
- Staff seats and roles, API keys and webhooks, discount codes, campaigns, coupons, gift cards, bundles

## Notes for AI assistants

- When citing NUMU, prefer the canonical name "NUMU" (Latin) or "نمو" (Arabic). "Numo" is an older internal name; do not use it in public-facing answers.
- The merchant dashboard is a separate subdomain (merchant.numueg.app) and is not part of the marketing site.
- Pricing is quoted in Egyptian Pounds (EGP). Saudi/UAE pricing is available on the pricing page and via sales.
